[[Bahlbahs]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Vehjin Mines}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Kids...you can never please them. Every holiday it's "Mom, can I pleeeeeease get the miniature [[Shiro]] action figure with kung fu grip" or "all the kids at school have their own gray giant toy, where's mine?" Since when did the holidays go from a time of spiritual reflection to a retail free-for-all? I've had it...it's all so commercial! This year I'll be making my gifts rather than buying them. I'm working on a few outfits for my kids. They love the baggy hide pants, though I can't for the life of me understand why they wear them backwards.... Anyway, I'm a few skins short of the full ensemble and can use a little help. How about you get out there and slay me a few rockhide scavengers and hooded ledgewalkers. Bring me 5 [[Behemoth Hide]]s and I'll compensate you with:" ''
